name: Codocraft Smart Notify
author: Codocraft Solutions

sections.description:
Codocraft Smart Notify is a comprehensive WordPress plugin designed to create and manage customizable notification bars. Perfect for announcements, promotions, newsletters, and user engagement.
Increase conversions, highlight offers, and engage visitors with smart notification bars.

Key Features

  • Multi-Bar Support: Manage multiple notification bars with priority-based display
  • Device Targeting: Target all devices, desktop only, or mobile only
  • Real-Time Analytics: Track views and clicks with visual charts
  • Responsive Design: Optimized for all devices and screen sizes
  • Professional Interface: Clean, intuitive admin panel for easy management

Core Features

  • Enable/Disable Control: Globally enable or disable all notification bars
  • Position Management: Display bars at the top or bottom of the page
  • Device Targeting: Target all devices, desktop only, or mobile only
  • Responsive Design: Automatic adaptation to all screen sizes
  • Multi-Bar System: Create and manage unlimited notification bars
  • Priority System: Set display priority (1-100) for multiple bars

Content Customization

  • Custom Text Messages
  • Subheading Support
  • Typography Options (font sizes: Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large)
  • Icon Library (6 built-in icons: Megaphone, Info, Warning, Check, Heart, Star)
  • Image Banner Support
  • Multiple Image Sizes (720×90, 468×60, 728×90, Fit to Banner)
  • Dismissible Bars
  • Multiple Bar Types:
    • Promo / Offers
    • Coupon / Deal Codes
    • Simple / Text Announcement
    • Image / Banner Notification
    • Urgent / Countdown

Button Customization

  • Call-to-Action Buttons
  • Style Variants (solid, outline, gradient)
  • Color Picker for background and text
  • Border Radius Options (Square, Rounded, Rounded More, Pill)
  • Link Behavior Control (Same Tab / New Tab)

Frequency Control

  • Show on every page load
  • Show once per session
  • Show once per day
  • Show once until closed

Analytics & Tracking

  • Real-Time Metrics
  • View Tracking
  • Click Tracking
  • Visual Charts (Weekly & Monthly)
  • Daily Breakdown
  • Per-bar analytics
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codocraft-smart-notify folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Codocraft Smart Notify in your admin menu to configure
sections.faq:
Can I display multiple bars simultaneously?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple active notification bars with priority-based display logic.

Is the plugin compatible with page builders?

Absolutely! It works seamlessly with popular page builders and themes.

How does the analytics tracking work?

The plugin uses AJAX calls to track views and clicks without affecting page load speed.

How can I control how often the bar appears?

You can set frequency control to show the bar on every page load, once per session, once per day, or once until closed.
